instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically download attachments for emails in the Inbox folder by enabling the appropriate setting in preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic attachment download in Thunderbird preferences. Evaluator uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric to verify the mail.server.default.mime_parts_on_demand preference is set to false (which enables automatic attachment downloading). Custom getter extracts prefs.js file from Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct preference key - evaluator checks 'mail.server.default.mime_parts_on_demand' which controls whether attachments are downloaded automatically (false) or on-demand (true)
Correct expected value - setting mime_parts_on_demand to false enables automatic downloading of all attachments, which matches the instruction requirement
Getter logic is correct - properly extracts prefs.js file from Thunderbird profile path and handles file reading
Metric logic is correct - check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js using regex, extracts preference values, and compares against expected rules

Minor limitation - instruction mentions 'for emails in the Inbox folder' but mime_parts_on_demand is an account-level setting that applies to all folders, not folder-specific. However, Thunderbird typically doesn't support per-folder attachment download settings, so this is the most appropriate verification method available
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider clarifying the instruction to reflect that this setting applies account-wide to all folders, not just the Inbox folder specifically
Optionally add metadata explanation that Thunderbird's attachment download settings are account-level, not per-folder
